core_obligations: Derive parts (4), (5) and (6) from the composition statement for the separation axioms (proof lines 623-626).
Reduce parts (1), (2) and (3) to (4), (5) and (6) by regarding X and Y as algebraic spaces over Spec(Z) (proof lines 627-629).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with six assertions: for f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, separatedness, quasi-separatedness and local separatedness of X (absolutely or over S) follow from the corresponding property of f and of Y (source lines 603-620). The proof shows that parts (4), (5) and (6) are immediate from the composition statement for the separation axioms and the definition of separatedness of an algebraic space, and that parts (1), (2) and (3) reduce to those by viewing X and Y as algebraic spaces over Spec(Z).
